List the tables published in a dataset

Source: R/discovery.R
cvm_tables.Rd

List the tables published in a dataset

Usage

cvm_tables(dataset, group = NULL)

Arguments

dataset

Short dataset id (e.g. "dfp").

group

Optional CKAN group slug (e.g. "companhias"). When NULL (default), the function resolves the group by uniqueness across the installed schema tree; when a dataset slug occurs in more than one group (a v0.4+ possibility), omitting group aborts with cvmdata_error_input_ambiguous.

Value

A character vector of table names, sorted alphabetically.

See also

Other discovery: cvm_codelist(), cvm_dataset_years(), cvm_datasets(), cvm_dictionary(), cvm_groups()

Examples

cvm_tables("dfp")
#>  [1] "bpa"                "bpp"                "composicao_capital"
#>  [4] "dfc_md"             "dfc_mi"             "dmpl"              
#>  [7] "dra"                "dre"                "dva"               
#> [10] "parecer"            "submissao"         
cvm_tables("dfp", group = "companhias")
#>  [1] "bpa"                "bpp"                "composicao_capital"
#>  [4] "dfc_md"             "dfc_mi"             "dmpl"              
#>  [7] "dra"                "dre"                "dva"               
#> [10] "parecer"            "submissao"
